verdict.why: The right build has a stepped cobblestone plinth with mossy variation, dressed stone window surrounds, a brick-roofed cottage with a chimney and porch, and a varied palette, so it reads as a lived-in building with character. The left build has a clean, tall lighthouse silhouette and a readable cottage, but its finish is flatter, with a thin base and a plain recolored look that would look more generic on a street.
